speaker: alice
text: Sports time, and if you can hear a faint rumble today that's not thunder, that's Mount Panorama warming up for the Bathurst 1000. The Great Race is back this long weekend and the whole town of Bathurst basically turns into one giant motorsport festival.

speaker: charlie
text: Love this time of year, there's nothing quite like The Mountain, a thousand kays, drivers pushing their cars and their nerves to the absolute limit. Even if you're not a petrolhead it's hard not to get swept up in it.

speaker: alice
text: And with the footy finals season also wrapping up around the country, it's just a cracking stretch for Aussie sport generally. Plenty to cheer for whether you're trackside or on the couch with snacks.
